long_biography.plain_text:
Alshinbayev trained as an engineer and held a research post in technical cybernetics before moving into finance. At Kazkommertsbank he became deputy chairman, managing director and head of its London office. He co-founded Meridian Capital in 2002, applying banking experience to corporate strategy, acquisitions and investments across emerging markets. His documented stake later represented 41% of Meridian's voting shares.

Unimilk was one of the clearest examples of his investment role. As a board member, Alshinbayev helped expand the dairy producer before its merger with Danone. He subsequently backed Food Union and handled finance, investor relations and corporate matters around that investment. He has also made sizeable personal investments in listed energy companies, a distinct activity that does not establish personal ownership of Meridian's wider portfolio.
long_biography.html:
Alshinbayev trained as an engineer and held a research post in technical cybernetics before moving into finance. At Kazkommertsbank he became deputy chairman, managing director and head of its London office. He co-founded Meridian Capital in 2002, applying banking experience to corporate strategy, acquisitions and investments across emerging markets. His documented stake later represented 41% of Meridian's voting shares.

Unimilk was one of the clearest examples of his investment role. As a board member, Alshinbayev helped expand the dairy producer before its merger with Danone. He subsequently backed Food Union and handled finance, investor relations and corporate matters around that investment. He has also made sizeable personal investments in listed energy companies, a distinct activity that does not establish personal ownership of Meridian's wider portfolio.
